rationale: The original short thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA as resistance, which now sits at $15.57 while the price has pushed up to $15.62 with the ask at $15.64, just one cent below hard invalidation. Broader market selling pressure has also eased (SPY improving from -1.40% to -1.29%), warranting an immediate exit now that the technical invalidation condition has been breached. Flipping to long is unattractive given the negative earnings catalyst, overhead VWAP resistance at $15.99, and a wide 19.2 bps spread.
